specName: A record of which hooks ran
request: Companion pipeline: each hook records whether it ran or was skipped, and the Workflow Builder can read the last run's outcome per hook.
expectations: Proving a hook ran: a record is the assistant's own report
Records for stock Spec Kit hooks in extensions.yml
Changing what a hook does or when it runs
context: constraint: one writer and one lock for .spec-context.json; history only grows
constraint: webview files belong to another team

FR-001.title: Each rendered hook ends with one instruction to record its outcome, naming the hook

FR-002.title: The record rides on any call of the existing run-record writer

FR-003.title: Records are appended under the shared lock, stamped by: ai, never rewritten

FR-004.title: Outcome is ran or skipped with optional one-line reason; anything else refused

FR-005.title: Hook records are never read as step boundaries

FR-006.title: Host read returns the latest spec run and its last outcome per hook, or no run

FR-007.title: The read passes over an unreadable run record

FR-008.title: Not seen is never written; each outcome carries a matching key

FR-009.title: node-hooks reference lists the skill type and the record rule

intent: Each Companion hook records ran or skipped, and the Workflow Builder can read the last run's outcome per hook

verified.result: [plan-check] plan.md: 3 call paths, 11 lines ·   WARNING plan.md:39  `apps/speckit-extension/scripts/spec_context.py` has no `:line`, so it is unverified (no-line) ·   0 error(s), 1 warning(s)

decisions.decision: Hook records live in a new append-only hookRuns list, not history[]
decisions.why: every history reader treats a row without substep/task and with an unknown kind as a step start
decisions.rejected: a history row with kind hook, which needs five readers changed

decisions.why: every step makes a writer call after its hooks, so the record costs no extra turn

decisions.decision: The build renders the whole hook address; the assistant only picks ran or skipped
decisions.why: shortest prompt and the record survives later config edits
decisions.rejected: JSON payloads or a slot id the writer resolves from companion.yml

decisions.decision: Most recent run is the spec with the newest at across history and hookRuns
decisions.why: folder numbers and mtimes do not order runs

plan.summary: Record line in each rendered hook, --hook-outcome writer to hookRuns[], host readHookRuns message
plan.key_finding: history[] cannot carry non-boundary rows without corrupting step timing in every reader

tasks.summary: 11 tasks, three disjoint story phases plus polish

approach: hook_render appends one record line naming the hook; write-context.py --hook-outcome appends to hookRuns[] under the shared lock and rides on any call; the host reads the newest spec and answers a readHookRuns message.
